title: Wave Alternatives 2026: Pricing and Features Compared
h1: Wave Alternatives 2026: Pricing and Features Compared
metaDescription: Wave alternatives compared: QuickBooks Online, FreshBooks, Xero, Zoho Books and Bonsai, with published plan prices, user limits and processing fees.
intro:
QuickBooks Online, FreshBooks, Xero, Zoho Books and Bonsai are five Wave alternatives. Zoho Books has a free plan, and the paid entry plans start at $15 to $38 per month. The right choice depends on whether you need a free tier, plans priced by client or invoice count, multi-user accounting, project and inventory tracking, or time tracking with proposals and contracts. The table lists each plan's published price, and the sections below add up user fees, add-ons and payment rates over a full year.

[Wave](https://www.waveapps.com/) lists a Starter plan at $0 with unlimited invoices, estimates, bills and bookkeeping records, while charging 2.9% + $0.60 per credit card transaction and 3.4% + $0.60 per American Express (Amex) transaction. Wave Pro lists at $19 United States Dollars (USD) per month billed monthly or $190 USD per year, which is also listed at $25 Canadian Dollars (CAD) per month or $250 CAD per year. Wave Pro adds automatic bank transaction imports through Plaid, automated categorization, receipt capture and a 2.9% + $0 transaction fee on the first 10 credit card payments each month.

For other accounting and billing shortlists, see the [QuickBooks alternatives](/alternatives/quickbooks/) guide, the [FreshBooks alternatives](/alternatives/freshbooks/) comparison, and the [best accounting software for freelancers roundup](/roundup/best-accounting-software-for-freelancers/). Readers can also browse the [comparison hub](/compare/) for wider software breakdowns.

chooseSection.heading: How to Choose a Wave Alternative
chooseSection.body:
Start with user seats. Wave Starter adds no extra user roles. Wave Pro lets owners invite contributors as admin, editor or viewer for $19 per month. QuickBooks Online prices access by tier, from 1 user on Simple Start to 25 on Advanced. Zoho Books gives 3 users on Standard for $20 per month. FreshBooks adds $11 per month for each extra team member.

Next, look at card fees. Wave charges 2.9% + $0.60 per credit card transaction on Starter. On a $1,000 customer invoice, that transaction fee equals $29.60. On Wave Pro, the fixed $0.60 fee is removed for the first 10 card transactions each month, which reduces the fee to $29.00 per $1,000 transaction. 

Last, ask whether the main job is full accounting records or plain client invoicing. Wave provides estimates, invoices, bills and bookkeeping records. Xero provides bank reconciliation, while Zoho Books includes bank feeds. Bonsai provides customer relationship management (CRM), contracts, scheduling, proposals and invoicing.

alternatives.heading: QuickBooks Online Plans and Multi-User Accounting
alternatives.body:
QuickBooks Online is an accounting application with tiered plans. Simple Start lists at $38 per month for 1 user and 2 accountant seats, covering income and expense tracking, basic reports, one connected bank and two invoices per month in the plan description. Essentials lists at $85 per month for 3 users, adding bulk invoice creation in beta, enhanced reporting and quarterly tax payment estimates. Plus lists at $140 per month for 5 users, introducing inventory tracking, project profitability and automatic bank reconciliation. Advanced costs $340 per month for up to 25 users, adding custom key performance indicators (KPIs), automated workflows and granular user permissions.

QuickBooks Online fits businesses that need inventory tracking and multi-user access controls.

 Wave Pro billed monthly costs $19 per month, which equals $228 per year. QuickBooks Online Simple Start costs $38 per month, totaling $456 per year. QuickBooks Online Plus costs $140 per month, which totals $1,680 per year. Selecting QuickBooks Online Plus instead of Wave Pro represents an annual subscription difference of $1,452.

 Wave provides unlimited invoicing and bookkeeping for $0 on its Starter plan, whereas QuickBooks Online requires an ongoing monthly fee of at least $38 following its 3-month introductory discount.

alternatives.heading: FreshBooks Client Limits and Invoicing Tools
alternatives.body:
FreshBooks is an invoicing and client billing application with tiered client limits. Lite lists at $23 per month and allows billing up to 5 active clients, along with expense tracking, estimates and tax-time reporting. Plus lists at $43 per month for up to 50 clients, adding client retainers, proposals, receipt scanning and accountant access. Premium lists at $70 per month and supports unlimited billable clients, customized email templates and project profitability tracking. FreshBooks also offers a custom-priced Select tier.

FreshBooks fits businesses that require integrated client proposals and client retainers. FreshBooks adds client retainers, proposals and project profitability tracking.

Evaluating the costs based on client count reveals clear differences. Wave allows unlimited billable clients on both its $0 Starter plan and its $19 monthly Pro plan. A business billing 25 clients lands on FreshBooks Plus at $43 per month, which totals $516 per year. If that business adds 2 team members at $11 per user per month, the FreshBooks subscription rises to $65 per month, or $780 per year. Wave Pro for that same team lists at $19 per month on Pro with no per-user price on its pricing page, which is $552 less per year than $780.

 A company invoicing 60 clients on FreshBooks must choose the $70 per month Premium tier ($840 annually), whereas Wave supports unlimited clients on its $0 Starter plan.

alternatives.heading: Xero Features and Invoice Caps
alternatives.body:
Xero is an accounting platform supporting bank reconciliation, bill tracking and reporting. In the United States, Early lists at $27 per month and allows quotes and 20 invoices per month and 5 bills, while providing bank reconciliation, 30-day cash flow forecasting and online invoice payment options. Growing lists at $59 per month, removing those caps, and adding automated bill entry, and a 60-day cash flow forecast. Established lists at $97 per month, adding multi-currency transactions, project time and cost tracking, employee expense claims and a 180-day cash flow forecast.

Xero fits businesses that need bank reconciliation and cash flow forecasting. Wave charges $19 per month on Pro to access user permissions and bank transaction categorization.

The arithmetic shifts based on monthly transaction volume. A business sending 30 invoices per month exceeds the Early plan cap of 20 invoices and must subscribe to Xero Growing at $59 per month, which totals $708 per year. Wave Pro costs $190 per year when billed annually, creating an annual savings of $518 compared to Xero Growing. On regular monthly billing, Xero Early costs $27 x 12 = $324 per year, whereas Wave Starter costs $0.

Xero falls short of Wave on entry-level billing allowances. Wave Starter permits unlimited invoices for $0, while Xero Early restricts users to 20 invoices per month at $27 per month.

alternatives.heading: Zoho Books Free Plan and Scaled Tiers
alternatives.body:
Zoho Books is a cloud accounting software suite with multiple operational tiers. Its Free plan costs $0 per month for 1 user and 1 accountant, limited to revenue under $50K per financial year and 1,000 invoices and 1,000 expenses per year. It supports invoices, quotes, expense logging, receipt auto-scans, mileage tracking and online payments. Standard lists at $20 per month ($15 per month billed annually) for 3 users, adding bank feeds, progress invoicing, 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC e-filing and application programming interface (API) access. Professional costs $50 per month ($40 billed annually) for 5 users, introducing purchase orders, multi-currency accounting, timesheet billing, project profitability and inventory tracking.

Zoho Books fits businesses that require inventory tracking, progress invoicing and 1099 filing. 

Comparing the annual costs demonstrates the value of Zoho Books for multi-user setups. A three-person company on Zoho Books Standard billed annually pays $15 x 12 = $180 per year. Wave Pro billed annually costs $190 per year. On monthly billing, Zoho Books Standard is $20 per month ($240 per year) compared to $19 per month ($228 per year) for Wave Pro. For 5 users needing inventory tools, Zoho Books Professional billed annually costs $40 x 12 = $480 per year.

alternatives.heading: Bonsai Per-User Pricing for Contracts and Billing
alternatives.body:
Bonsai is a business management and invoicing platform with per-user pricing. Bonsai charges on a per-user, per-month schedule. On monthly billing, Basic costs $15, Essentials costs $25, Premium costs $39 and Elite costs $59 per user. On annual billing, the rates drop to $9, $19, $29 and $49 per user per month. Basic covers time tracking, task management, client management (CRM), unlimited projects and unlimited clients. Invoicing, online payments, contracts, proposals, scheduling, client portals and expense tracking begin at the Essentials tier.

Bonsai fits businesses that require contracts, proposals, scheduling and invoicing in one subscription. 

Examining multi-user agency pricing highlights the difference in billing structures. A two-person team using Bonsai Essentials on monthly billing pays 2 x $25 = $50 per month, totaling $600 per year. On annual billing, the same two users pay 2 x $19 = $38 per month, or $456 per year. Wave Pro costs $19 per month ($228 per year) or $190 billed annually, with no per-user price listed on its pricing page. Choosing Wave Pro over Bonsai Essentials saves that two-person team $266 per year on annual billing.

 Bonsai includes income and expense tracking starting on Essentials, while Wave includes bookkeeping records on its Starter plan.

alternatives.heading: Who This Is Not For
alternatives.body:
Wave and its alternatives leave some businesses out.

- Wave fits poorly for businesses that need inventory tracking or granular multi-user permissions. Wave's pricing page lists neither on Starter.
- QuickBooks Online fits poorly for solo owners who only invoice, since the lowest plan is $38 per month.
- FreshBooks fits poorly for businesses with more than 50 clients, because only Premium at $70 per month covers unlimited billable clients.
- Zoho Books Free fits poorly for businesses with revenue of $50K or more per financial year.
- Bonsai fits poorly for larger teams, because every plan is priced per user per month.
- Wave Advisors is a separate bookkeeping service starting at $149 per month. It is not part of the $0 Starter plan.

alternatives.heading: What Would Change Our Answer on Wave Alternatives
alternatives.body:
Several pricing moves or functional updates could alter the comparative value of these platforms:

- Wave modifying its $0 Starter plan by placing caps on invoice volume, active clients or bookkeeping records.
- Wave expanding the discounted 2.9% + $0 credit card rate on Wave Pro beyond the current cap of 10 transactions per month.
- QuickBooks Online altering the monthly list prices for Simple Start ($38), Essentials ($85) or Plus ($140).
- Xero removing or adjusting the 20-invoice and 5-bill monthly limit on its $27 Early plan.
- Zoho Books changing the user allowances on its Standard ($20 per month for 3 users) or Professional ($50 per month for 5 users) tiers.
- Bonsai adjusting its per-user pricing model.

stillBetterFit.heading: When Wave Is Still the Better Fit
stillBetterFit.body:
Wave fits businesses that want bookkeeping records and unlimited invoicing without a monthly subscription fee. Wave Starter delivers unlimited estimates, invoices, bills and bookkeeping records for $0. 

For businesses wanting automated bank feeds, Wave Pro at $19 per month billed monthly or $190 per year billed annually costs less than QuickBooks Online Simple Start at $38 per month or Xero Early at $27 per month. Wave Pro also includes unlimited receipt scanning using optical character recognition (OCR), auto-categorization of transactions and automated late payment reminders sent at 3, 7 and 14 days past the invoice due date.

Wave also integrates optional services when needed. Owners can add Wave Advisors bookkeeping starting at $149 per month for monthly financial statements, payroll starting from $25 or $40 per month, and live chat or email support operating Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 4:45 PM Eastern.

verdict:
Wave Starter delivers $0 invoicing and bookkeeping records, while Wave Pro provides automated bank feeds and receipt capture for $19 per month. QuickBooks Online fits businesses that need inventory management and granular user roles. Xero fits businesses that want cash flow forecasting and bank reconciliation. Zoho Books fits those that want project profitability and inventory tracking, and Bonsai fits those that bundle proposals, contracts and scheduling with billing.

For a Wave alternative, the concrete next step is to count your user seats and monthly client invoices, then read the matching plan row in the table above.

faqs.question: Is Wave really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wave Starter costs $0 per month and includes unlimited invoices, estimates, bills and bookkeeping records. Wave charges optional fees for payment processing, optional receipt scanning, payroll and live support.

faqs.question: How does Wave make money?
faqs.answer: Wave generates revenue through transaction processing fees on credit card and American Express payments, monthly subscriptions for Wave Pro ($19 USD per month), receipt capture add-ons, payroll processing and Wave Advisors bookkeeping services.

faqs.question: What does Wave Pro cost?
faqs.answer: Wave Pro costs $19 USD per month when billed monthly or $190 USD per year when billed annually. In Canada, it lists at $25 CAD per month or $250 CAD per year. It adds automated bank transaction imports, receipt capture, automated late payment reminders and discounted payment processing.

faqs.question: Does Wave charge for credit card payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wave Starter charges 2.9% + $0.60 per credit card transaction and 3.4% + $0.60 per American Express transaction. Wave Pro discounts credit card processing to 2.9% + $0 for the first 10 transactions each month.

faqs.question: Which Wave alternative has the most users included?
faqs.answer: User allowances vary: QuickBooks Online Advanced includes up to 25 users, Zoho Books Ultimate includes 15 users, and Bonsai charges per user. In contrast, QuickBooks Online limits Simple Start to 1 user and Essentials to 3 users, Zoho Books Standard covers 3 users, and Bonsai charges per user.
